articles.title: How a 23-Year-Old Pop Star Gave a 66-Year-Old Rock Icon His First Solo Hit
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo's third album obliterated streaming records, with all 13 tracks landing in the top 30. The most unexpected outcome? Robert Smith of The Cure scored his first solo chart hit ever—at age 66—thanks to a collaboration. Even a mysterious masked math-rock duo suddenly has two albums charting.

articles.title: Elephants in the Alps: The Podcast Rewriting History If Carthage Had Crushed Rome
articles.summary: A new 'Almost History' episode explores one of antiquity's biggest what-ifs: a Carthaginian victory in the Punic Wars. Historian Eve MacDonald reveals how close Hannibal came to toppling Rome—and how a different outcome might have reshaped language, trade, and culture across the Western world.

articles.title: Abandoned Infants and Food Fights: How Climate Extremes Are Breaking Monkey Societies
articles.summary: During a severe El Niño drought, devoted capuchin monkey mothers abandoned their infants—a behavior scientists had never seen. New research analyzing 33 years of data reveals that climate extremes intensify food competition within groups and upend territorial dynamics, pushing these primates to their limits.
